breakdown.description: `pimpleFoam` is a fluid solver and cannot compute the elastic deformation of the solid flap. A fluid-structure interaction (FSI) problem fundamentally requires two different sets of governing equations and thus two solvers (one for fluid, one for solid) that are coupled at their interface.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly replaces pimpleFoam as the solid solver with solidDisplacementFoam, and specifies two-way FSI coupling with displacement and traction exchange via solids4foam. This matches the ground truth's requirement for separate fluid and solid solvers with proper interface coupling.
